Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us
Urine analysis shows significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), marked leukocyturia, positive nitrites, hematuria, and leukocyte esterase, consistent with a urinary tract infection. Presence of glucose in urine may suggest hyperglycemia or diabetes. Low specific gravity could indicate dilute urine. No ketones or casts detected. Recommend clinical correlation and further evaluation for diabetes and urinary tract infection management.
